C1420.title: Re-measurement of Sandwich Attacks and Arbitrage Reordering in the Ethereum MEV Ecosystem
C1420.summary: An academic study released in May 2024 re-measures the Ethereum MEV ecosystem, identifying arbitrage trades and sandwich attacks as the two primary MEV activities. It finds that approximately $675 million in MEV value was extracted prior to Ethereum's September 2022 Merge. The research designs a profit-identification algorithm and analyzes the influence of private transaction architectures on MEV

references.title: Remeasuring the Arbitrage and Sandwich Attacks of Maximal Extractable Value in Ethereum
